reason: Ran the documented YAMLMapper.readTree(InputStream) on the pinned jackson-dataformat-yaml 2.23.0 (jar SHA-256 971bce7e65b63c7f78965c29aa35370143f01e21a420d02bb3cde32069360689) with jackson-databind/core 2.23.0 and SnakeYAML 2.5 (e6682acf1ace77508ef13649cbf4f8d09d2cf5457bdb61d25ffb6ac0233d78dd) on local Temurin 21: every scalar, collection and block scalar matched the oracle, but both aliases came back as the anchor name string (service.settings = "base", order.yaml item 3 = "shared") instead of the anchored node. Jackson exposes YAML anchors/aliases as Object Ids for databind identity handling, not as expanded tree nodes, so the generic tree path does not meet the alias part of the control. Stays a lead; shared SnakeYAML family.
